title: agent-sandbox-runtime unauthenticated arbitrary Python execution
claim: POST /v1/run executes arbitrary Python with no authentication on a loopback instance bound to 127.0.0.1:8001.
ceiling: Does NOT establish remote exploitability: host must be reachable on 0.0.0.0 (README docker run -p 8000:8000) for a remote attacker; this verify is loopback-only.
